appointment.moduleDisabled: Enable the Appointments module to manage this booking.

callback.moduleDisabled: Enable the Callbacks module to manage this callback.

job.moduleDisabled: Enable the Jobs module to manage this job.

external.oursNote: This is our own booking's synced copy — manage it from the system calendar.
external.externalNote: External events are view-only here; edit them in Outlook.

cancelDialog.title: Cancel this appointment?
cancelDialog.description: The slot frees up, the synced calendar copy is removed, and the contact is emailed a cancellation.

reassignDialog.title: Reassign appointment
reassignDialog.description: The booking keeps its time — the synced calendar copy moves to the new assignee.

rescheduleDialog.title: Reschedule appointment
rescheduleDialog.description: Pick a new time — the contact will be emailed the update.

createDialog.title: New appointment
createDialog.description: Book a time for a contact. Duration follows your calendar settings.

slotPicker.pickDate: Pick a date to see open slots.
slotPicker.loadError: Couldn't load slots — switch to a custom time or try another day.
slotPicker.empty: No open slots this day — try another day, or use a custom time.
slotPicker.customWarning: Custom times skip the availability check — double-booking is allowed.

empty.title: No calendar connected
empty.description: Connect your Outlook calendar to see it side by side with the system calendar. Each team member connects their own.

broken.title: Calendar needs reconnecting
broken.description: The connection to {email} stopped working. Reconnect it to bring this view back.
broken.descriptionNoEmail: The connection to your Outlook account stopped working. Reconnect it to bring this view back.

connected.unavailable: Outlook didn't respond just now, so events are hidden. This usually clears up on its own — try again in a minute.
